title: sync script: RESOLVED sentinel satisfiable by branch-controlled content anywhere in session log
description: Reviewer kimi-k3 pass 2.4. grep -qx 'RESOLVED' on combined stdout+stderr (:121) matches an exact RESOLVED line from any echoed tool output or intermediate text, not just the final message (validated empirically this round: a stub session that printed RESOLVED without resolving was caught only by the later marker gate, not the sentinel). Fix: require the sentinel as the LAST non-empty line (awk 'NF{l=$0} END{exit !(l=="RESOLVED")}').
